summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K by Tonix Pharmaceuticals announcing program updates on its TNX-4800 Lyme disease vaccine candidate and the presentation of Phase 1 data at a symposium. It includes planned Phase 2 study design and a Type C FDA meeting. No special situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist, restructuring, etc.) is present. The registrant (issuer) is not taking any corporate action—it is merely disclosing clinical progress. Therefore, no special situation category applies. What to watch: eventual FDA feedback and initiation of Phase 2 field study. Risk-arb angle: none.
